scope: All installed dpkg/source identities in every package-database layer of the pinned recipe, including superseded ancestor versions. Final copyright paths are resolved and byte-bound; earlier retained versions are explicit, not silently exempted.
release_status: Not a release approval. Source archive URLs/hashes were anonymously downloaded and matched signed Ubuntu indexes. Before conveying an image, provide the applicable equivalent source access and all license notices; vendor and Python closures are separate.
